**

La Crusca in Kufstein

** Discover authentic Italian cuisine in the heart of **Tirol**! **La Crusca**, located in the charming town of **Kufstein**, invites you to savor the finest flavors of Italy—right in the Alps. Our cozy restaurant offers a warm atmosphere where you can enjoy classic dishes like fresh pasta, crispy *bruschetta*, and, of course, a perfectly brewed espresso. Whether you're craving a hearty *risotto alla Milanese* or a light *caprese* salad, our menu has something for every palate. After your meal, indulge in a delicious Italian dessert—try our decadent *tiramisu* or a slice of *panna cotta* with fresh berries. **La Crusca** is the perfect spot for a romantic dinner, a family gathering, or a quick lunch break during your travels through **Tirol**. Come experience the taste of Italy in the stunning landscapes of the **Alps**—just a short drive from **Innsbruck** and **Salzburg**. We look forward to welcoming you! *Buon appetito!*
